retrievalProfile.description: A monochromatic blue layout featuring a circular portrait inset against a background of subtle botanical patterns and staggered high-contrast serif typography.
excludeWhen: modern sans-serif minimalist designs are requested
landscape-oriented photography is the primary focus

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition dominated by a deep cerulean blue palette. It features a circular portrait of a man in the upper right quadrant, framed by a thin light blue stroke. The background consists of a darker blue, low-contrast pattern of holly leaves and berries. Large, white, high-contrast serif text is arranged in a staggered, multi-line format across the left and bottom areas.
coreVisualRelationships: Circular portrait frame balanced by staggered text blocks
High-contrast white typography against a monochromatic blue field
Subtle botanical background pattern providing texture without competing with the subject
Tonal harmony between the portrait's lighting and the overall blue color scheme
coreInvariants: Monochromatic blue color palette across all elements
Circular framing for the primary photographic subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is a portrait located in the upper right, occupying approximately one-third of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular portrait serves as the primary anchor, while the large 'Cool' text acts as a secondary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left text, moves to the circular portrait, then follows the staggered text down to the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Negative space is filled with a low-opacity holly leaf pattern to maintain visual interest without clutter.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Light blue for the circular frame and subtle highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between text and background; low saturation variance within the blue tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast modern serif with vertical stress
letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
Unbracketed or lightly bracketed horizontal serifs
Ball terminals on lowercase characters like 'c' and 'r'

composition.relationshipToImage: Text wraps around the circular portrait

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying scales to create hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and vertical stress of the original typography.
Provides the elegant, modern serif look with sharp terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a square monochromatic blue background with a subtle, dark blue pattern of holly leaves and berries. Place a circular portrait of a man in the upper right quadrant, framed with a thin light blue line. Apply a blue tint to the portrait to match the background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large white text in a high-contrast Didone serif font. Stagger the words across the left and bottom of the frame, ensuring the text flows around the circular portrait.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic blue and white?
Is the portrait contained within a circular frame?
Does the typography exhibit high stroke contrast?
Is the background pattern subtle enough to not distract from the text?

mustRedesign: Specific artist names and album titles

mustAchieve: Balanced distribution of text and image

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible against the background pattern.
Ensure the circular frame is perfectly round.
Verify that the blue tint on the portrait matches the background hue.
Confirm the typography uses a high-contrast serif style.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic Blue Base + Circular Inset Portrait + Staggered Didone Typography + Botanical Texture Overlay
